description: Returns one processed product including productStatus.itemLevelIssues (code, severity, resolution, description) — the place to see why a product is disapproved. Identify the product either with `product` ("contentLanguage~feedLabel~offerId", e.g. "en~US~sku123", or the base64url base64EncodedName; legacy local products use a local~ prefix) or with the three components content_language + feed_label + offer_id. A product inserted moments ago may 404 until async processing finishes (minutes).

account.description: Merchant Center account ID (digits, e.g. "123456"). Omit to use the GOOGLE_MERCHANTS_ACCOUNT_ID default.

content_language.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 content language, e.g. "en". Used with feed_label + offer_id.

feed_label.description: Feed label, e.g. "US". Used with content_language + offer_id.

offer_id.description: The merchant's offer ID (SKU). Used with content_language + feed_label.

product.description: Product ID: "contentLanguage~feedLabel~offerId" (e.g. "en~US~sku123") or the base64url base64EncodedName. Omit when passing the three components separately.

name: get_product
title: Get a processed product
